cross_member_patterns.pattern: P1 - The contract was amended twice mid-verification and 14 of 16 member reports were measured against the pre-amendment text.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: Only vitaminc_conformed_report.json (23 mentions) and quant_misbind_conformed_report.json (4) cite C-A1 or C-A2. docs/experiments/dataset-contract.md was last written 2026-08-17 09:11:44; eleven of the sixteen reports were written before that stamp and three after it without citing either amendment. C-A2 itself tabulates the damage: three members, one clause, verdicts differing only by which reading the agent took.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: Four C1 FAILs and one entire conforming pipeline (psiloqa's 9,859-row F2 cut) were produced by a test the contract has since struck. Re-reading, not re-measuring, resolves them.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P2 - C2 is the modal failure (5 of 11 members, 75.78% of the mix) and every instance is an eval-construction defect, not a training-data defect.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: Not one C2 failure touches the blind arena. All of them are mechanism evals built from the same source pools their neighbouring members draw from, and certified by exact matching against the one lane they were built beside - exactly the two failures named in C2's own provenance.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: The lanes were specified without a member-versus-all-surfaces gate at eval build time. This is a defect in the eval pipeline, and it recurs once per corpus that supplies both a member and an eval.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P3 - C2's three-string-form instrument is blind to the channel carrying the largest leaks: document identity.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: tabfact's first pass read a 1.8% string leak on R17-H143_evalset; the document channel reads 350 of 350 documents and 683 of 1,050 rows. quant_misbind's conformed pass found R20-H177_eval_B sharing 229 of 458 documents and 458 of 1,000 pairs where no string form fires. Both were only visible after a rebuild made document ids resolvable.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: A member can pass C2 on all three forms and still supply the evidence an eval is read on. The clause does not name the channel.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P4 - C1's mandated containment instrument is predicate-blind for every lane whose corruption is not lexical, which is three of the five lanes.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: quant_scale_unit: the lane's own H148 anti-shortcut rule forces the label-bearing unit token out of the evidence on BOTH legs, so 94.73% of pairs score exactly equal and the gap is 0.00072. path_bind: the corruption is token ORDER, so 81.6% of pairs are byte-equal on the measure, containment AUROC 0.4975, and the negative leg reads 0.002 ABOVE the positive. quant_misbind: containment AUROC 0.499783 by construction. Each executor had to bring its own instrument - unit-resolved attestation (0.0321 vs 0.1011), contiguous-run attestation (0.0 vs 1.0), binding-level re-derivation (0.0 vs 1.0).
cross_member_patterns.consequence: The clause as specified cannot certify a binding-, order- or unit-corrupting lane in either direction. C-A1 bullet 4 and C-A2 test 2 name this; both were adopted after the lanes were built.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P5 - C5's scope boundary exempts 90.15% of the mix from the leak bar it enforces on 9.85%.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: All six source corpora fall outside 'constructed lane or paired-contrast eval'. Measured claim-only AUROC where an executor ran the probe anyway: halueval 0.9519, ragtruth_en 0.7965, ragtruth_translated 0.7810, tabfact 0.5985, vitaminc 0.4998, psiloqa not measured. Four of five breach the 0.55 lane bar; 253,305 rows (33.30% of the mix) carry a claim-only channel above it under no binding clause.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: halueval sits exactly on the boundary - a source corpus whose negative leg is LLM-constructed on a pair-contrast structure - and its verdict flips on the reading. The boundary is unspecified, not merely debatable.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P6 - C8's retrieval-date limb is a repository-wide gap, applied inconsistently across members on identical evidence.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: Verified directly: no sidecar under data/external/datasets/ records a fetch date except dataset-minicheck.md. Six members PASS C8 on archive/zip timestamp evidence or on a bare assertion; ragtruth_en FAILS C8 for the same absence. Three executors (psiloqa, vitaminc, tabfact) flagged the weakness inside a PASS.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: One fetch-script change writing the date into every sidecar closes the limb for the whole repository and removes the only surviving ragtruth_en failure.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P7 - The same FEVEROUS defect drew opposite fixability verdicts from two executors.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: quant_misbind's report: 'PIPELINE - every failure is a pipeline or artifact-management defect; none is a property of TabFact or FEVEROUS as corpora', and its conforming build dropped the FEVEROUS third whole. quant_scale_unit's report on the identical file (tmp/R14_H133_feverous.parquet, 1,040 of its 5,540 rows): CORPUS_PROPERTY.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: Fixability is being returned as a judgement rather than a measurement. One of the two labels is wrong and the coordinator's triage of 35,540 lane rows turns on which.

cross_member_patterns.pattern: P8 - C7 caught nothing and cannot: it has no volume bar.
cross_member_patterns.evidence: 11 of 11 PASS, including quant_scale_unit at 27.70% of registered scale and attr_pool's rebuild at 15,558 rows below its registered floor.
cross_member_patterns.consequence: Registered-scale shortfalls of 72% and 78% are invisible to the contract. If registered volume is load-bearing for an arm, C7 is not the clause that protects it.
